summary.text: Judith Lindsey is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired educator, she said in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey that she has served more than 20 years on the Candia Planning Board and Conservation Commission.

paragraphs.text: Judith Lindsey attended Grand Valley State College and earned a graduate degree from Rivier College in 1993, and her career experience includes working as an educator.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she taught at the K-8 Henry W. Moore School in Candia for 23 years and is a 24-year resident of the town.
Ballotpedia's campaign-finance listing records Lindsey as having lost the 2024 general election for New Hampshire House of Representatives Rockingham 2.

In that survey, she listed protecting the environment, supporting public schools and finding a balance between property taxes and school funding, and affordable housing and living wages among her priorities.
